name: Software end-of-life date changes — which dates moved and what they were before
description: A change log of software end-of-life and end-of-support dates across 462 products, built by diffing the endoflife.date API between snapshots: for each changed date, the product, release cycle, which field moved, the old value and the new value. Answers 'did the Python 3.9 EOL date change?', 'which Node.js support dates were extended this month?', and 'what EOL dates moved in July 2026?' — the question shape nobody publishes. endoflife.date tracks current state; endoflife.ai publishes a free monthly digest of what is critical now; neither publishes the before-and-after diff. New product additions are also captured. This is a parser case: the API returns structured JSON, no model supplies values.
